description.value: Nooi's New York Hotdog & Coffee is a lively street-food counter on White Rock's Marine Drive offering an eclectic menu that ranges from jumbo hotdogs, BBQ chicken skewers, corn dogs, and ramen to an extensive espresso and specialty beverage program. The Marine Drive waterfront is one of BC's most popular coastal cycling corridors, placing this spot directly in the path of touring cyclists. Sweet options—popsicles, snow cones, croffles, and milkshakes—complement savoury choices, making it viable for a quick mid-ride refuel.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully loads and corroborates the OSM address (15529 Marine Dr, White Rock, BC V4B 1C9) and phone (236-632-2217); both match OSM. No website content mentions bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities, so those remain null. The menu lists a 'Vegetable' ramen option by name, providing positive evidence for at least one vegetarian item; no other cyclist amenities are documented.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM primary name is 'New York Hotdog & Coffee' but the website consistently brands the business as 'Nooi's New York Hotdog & Coffee'; this fuller name also appears as the OSM alt_name. Consider updating the OSM primary name to match.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active food and beverage business situated directly on the Marine Drive cycling corridor in White Rock, offering a wide variety of quick-service food and drink options well-suited to touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Ramen menu explicitly lists 'Vegetable' as a named noodle option alongside Bacon, Chicken, and Beef variants
